topic: Current roster eligibility follows departure and return
problem: Historical player advice could point at an unavailable roster member
solution: Preserved Echo0.72 finding with departure explanation, re-signed actual terms and verified advice returns while short-squad blocker clears
lesson: Historical findings stay intact while current membership gates actionable controls; native release cancellation adds neither decision nor HTTP request

topic: Resolved weekly development and bounded usage agree in integration
problem: Players need visible reasons for growth and analytics needs separate usage evidence
solution: Full S1W2 report matches five report-time players and Vortex Rest/match/career attribution; three decisions and two bounded control receipts reconcile separately
lesson: Attribute actual outcomes to server-resolved sources and distinguish search/report initiation counts from accepted decisions and causal claims

topic: Read actual state before completing an observation
problem: Incomplete cloned-save fixture opened lobby and root prematurely marked expected Dashboard behavior met
solution: Retained unsupported row and failed screenshots, added explicit diagnosis/recovery observations and copied identified companion files without exposing credentials
lesson: Do not finish a CSV row from expected tool behavior; inspect result before judgment and preserve later corrections rather than rewriting evidence
